faqList.question: Can I fit custom prescription or progressive lenses into OPTIQUE ATELIER frames?
faqList.answer: Yes. All of our frames feature optical-grade bevel channels engineered for cold and warm lens insertion, fully compatible with single-vision, progressive, high-index blue light, and polarized sunglass prescriptions from any licensed optometrist.

faqList.question: How does the complimentary 30-day Home Atelier Try-On work?
faqList.answer: We provide insured, expedited courier delivery worldwide. Take up to 30 days to test the fit and optical balance in your daily environment. If you need a different bridge width or style, returns and exchanges are completely complimentary.

faqList.question: What materials are used, and how should I care for bio-acetate frames?
faqList.answer: Our frames are sculpted from plant-based Mazzucchelli bio-acetate and Japanese titanium. Clean gently with lukewarm water and our custom woven microfiber cloth. Store in the included molded magnetic leather case when not in use.

zh.tag: 客户服务 & 常见问题
zh.title: 常见问题解答

faqList.question: 是否支持配置定制近视镜片或渐进多焦点镜片？
faqList.answer: 支持。我们所有镜架均采用光学级槽口设计，适配各类近视、远视、防蓝光及偏光太阳镜片。

faqList.question: 30 天工坊试戴服务是如何运作的？
faqList.answer: 我们提供全程保价快递。您可以在收到后 30 天内自由试戴。如有尺寸或款式调整需求，均享免费退换。

faqList.question: 使用了哪些材质？板材镜架应如何保养？
faqList.answer: 镜框采用植物基生物醋酸纤维与日本钛金属。建议使用温水与擦镜布清洁，存放于随附的磁吸皮革盒中。
